bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Atack penalty by 2 DN when it attacks with both its Hyperphase Threshers and Ophydian Claws, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

bonuses.name: Tunneller
bonuses.text: This Threat can tunnel underground whilst moving. While this Threat is underground it cannot be targeted by attack Tests.

abilities.name: Tunnelling Horrors
abilities.text: Ophydan Destroyers emerge from tunnelling. All opponents of the Ophydian Destroyer must make a DN 2 Initiative Test or are Ambushed.

abilities.name: Hardwired for Destruction
abilities.text: When you spend Ruin to re-roll all failing dice for a Ophydian Destroyer’s Weapon Skill Test, results of 3 and 4 count as Icons and results of 5 and 6 count as Exalted Icons.

abilities.name: Whipcoil Bodies
abilities.text: When targeted by a melee attack, an Ophydian Destroyer can use its Reaction to increase its Defence by +1.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.
